notes: Early layer, so this is a spelling unit. In the probe, Luke (Gospel or a person) scored 0.26-0.50 of max, Fluke 0.39 and Sicherheitslücken 0.89, while Mark, Mike and Duke scored about 0.02. Near misses swap in other names or words.
